dedupe_keys.name: data and code on extreme inflow and lowflow analysis for alpine reservoirs

description: Data and Code on Extreme Inflow and Lowflow Analysis for Alpine Reservoirs is a dataset listed in Swiss national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by EnviDat: das Umwelt-Datenportal. Summary Dataset of daily inflow to Luzzone reservoir in Ticino, Switzerland R scripts used to generate return levels for low reservoir inflow, low precipitation, high inflow, and extreme high precipitation based on various methods from extreme value analysis Data The dataset included here is the "natural" reservoir inflow for the Luzzone reservoir. Coverage: Switzerland. The portal files it under the publisher EnviDat: das Umwelt-Datenportal. It offers 2 resource(s) in CSV, ZIP. The portal shows 2026-09-26 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is http://www.opendefinition.org/licenses/cc-by-sa. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support drinking water network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-ch-portal.
